policy: DO NOT TUNE. Freeze the strategy parameters and gates. Any change invalidates the paper track record and must be recorded as a new baseline_id.

primary_strategy.name: RSI2OversoldSwing
primary_strategy.entry: rsi_2 < rsi2_max AND close > close_prev (bullish turn)
primary_strategy.exit: stop = entry - stop_atr_mult * atr_14 ; target = entry + target_atr_mult * atr_14 ; max_hold_days cap
primary_strategy.notes: Positive net expectancy after full delivery costs in ALL FOUR 5-year walk-forward folds (iteration 114, config R0_rsi2_10|sl2_tp3).

secondary_strategy.name: NR7SwingBreakout
secondary_strategy.notes: NOT independently walk-forward validated. Included only as a portfolio diversifier; do not promote on its own without a dedicated fold test.

sizing_and_gates.directive: Multi-day delivery holds only. No intraday MIS. Fixed rupee risk per trade.

acceptance_bands.note: Realized is 'on_track' when closed_trades >= min, net > 0, win_rate >= 0.90*expected, and profit_factor >= 0.90*expected.

known_failures.intraday: All intraday arms (1h and 5m) are net-negative after statutory fees in walk-forward (iteration 115). Do NOT trade intraday with this capital.
known_failures.deepseek_veto: No measurable value as a binary gate (iteration 116): 15 calls changed zero trades. Use AI for ranking/analysis only.
